status.description:
The Status of the operation being performed.
 * `ADD` - The external user is added in this sync
 * `UPDATE` - The external user is updated in this sync
 * `DELETE` - The external user is deleted in this sync
 * `NO_OPERATION` - No changes made on the external user in this sync
